billing: none — no provider resource was ever created for this run
what_happened: the chain was built in order — grant, launch-bound readiness (PASS, 174/0/0/0), authorization at a re-quoted live securePrice of $1.09/h, exact-session bundle — and then every pre-provider gate was run at $0 under `--dry-run` before creating a resource. ALL ELEVEN PASSED, including the repaired campaign continuation gate: $2.5425 settled plus $33.2098 of remaining work is $35.7523 against the $35.7600 campaign ceiling, which the old $33.2099 session ceiling would have refused. The dry run then stopped before provider creation exactly as designed and nothing billed. The real launch, seconds later, was refused: `open_run` found the run already recorded.
why_a_fresh_chain: EVERY launcher invocation records its run, deliberately, so a launcher that died mid-flight cannot be silently re-invoked against one authorization — and `open_run` then refuses a recorded or occupied directory. `--dry-run` inherited both, so the invocation whose entire contract is 'change nothing' consumed this one-use chain at $0. That is the AGENTS.md P12.1 case in as many words: a formal launcher invocation that aborts before measurement began is an engineering subrun, it consumed its chain even at $0, and the response is to close it, repair, and build a fresh chain under a new attempt identity. No budget moved, no science moved, and no approval is owed.

the_defect_and_its_repair.defect: `--dry-run` advertised 'run every $0 gate and stop before provider creation' while consuming the one-use chain it existed to de-risk. The flag was a trap and the trap fired on its first use.
the_defect_and_its_repair.repair: a dry run now writes its evidence to its own run directory (`<run_id>-dryrun`) and leaves the real one pristine and unconsumed. `args.run_id` is NOT redirected: every gate resolves the grant, readiness record, authorization, bundle and the campaign's prior attempts from it, so a dry run under a different id would check a different chain and prove nothing about the one about to launch. Only the output locations move.
the_defect_and_its_repair.regression: tests/c2_behavioural_preflight/test_behavioural_continuation.py :: test_a_dry_run_writes_to_its_own_run_directory and test_the_dry_run_id_is_not_a_campaign_attempt_number. Mutated two ways — the dry run pointed back at the real directory, and `args.run_id` redirected instead so the gates would read the wrong chain — both caught.
the_defect_and_its_repair._why_the_dry_run_id_is_not_an_attempt: `attempt4-dryrun` has a non-numeric suffix, so the launch guards' numeric `newest_attempt` ignores it and cannot mistake it for the newest chain.
